name: Active Connections
description: Show active PostgreSQL connections grouped by state.

steps.label: Query pg_stat_activity
steps.command: psql -U postgres -c "SELECT count(*), state FROM pg_stat_activity GROUP BY state;"

name: Database Sizes
description: List all databases with their sizes, largest first.

steps.label: Query pg_database_size
steps.command: psql -U postgres -c "SELECT datname, pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(datname)) AS size FROM pg_database ORDER BY pg_database_size(datname) DESC;"

name: Table Sizes
description: List top 20 tables by size in a given database.

steps.label: Query pg_total_relation_size
steps.command: psql -U postgres -d {{database}} -c "SELECT schemaname, tablename, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(schemaname||'.'||tablename)) AS size FROM pg_tables ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(schemaname||'.'||tablename) DESC LIMIT 20;"

name: Long-Running Queries
description: Find queries running longer than a given threshold.

steps.label: Find slow queries
steps.command: psql -U postgres -c "SELECT pid, now() - query_start AS duration, left(query, 120) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active' AND query_start < now() - interval '{{minutes}} minutes' ORDER BY duration DESC;"

name: Vacuum Analyze
description: Run VACUUM ANALYZE on a database to reclaim space and update planner stats.

name: Check Locks
description: Show blocked queries and lock holders.

steps.label: Query pg_locks + pg_stat_activity
steps.command: psql -U postgres -c "SELECT bl.pid AS blocked_pid, a.query AS blocked_query, kl.pid AS lock_holder_pid, ka.query AS lock_holder_query FROM pg_catalog.pg_locks bl JOIN pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity a ON bl.pid = a.pid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_locks kl ON kl.transactionid = bl.transactionid AND kl.pid != bl.pid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity ka ON kl.pid = ka.pid WHERE NOT bl.granted;"
